profile.summary: jdalton is a senior JavaScript developer with deep expertise in Lodash, functional programming patterns, and utility library development. Their contributions demonstrate strong skills in dependency management (via Greenkeeper), build tooling (webpack, requirejs), and maintaining legacy JavaScript ecosystems. The developer follows clean Git workflows, aligns contributions with project roadmaps, and has hands-on experience with Node.js backend tooling. While primarily focused on utility libraries, their work suggests proficiency in backend JavaScript environments and automated CI/CD processes.
